description: This PHP source file defines the TimezoneAPI class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling API requests related to timezones during installation. It extends an abstract REST controller and implements a method to retrieve timezone data.

classes.name: TimezoneAPI
classes.description: A controller class that provides a REST API endpoint to retrieve timezone data during the installation process.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the API, returning a list of timezones processed via InstanceCreationHelper.
